consigne: Cherche chaque exercice au brouillon avant d'ouvrir le corrigé.

exercices.enonce: Complète : I can't stand ___ (to wait) in queues.
exercices.reponse: I can't stand waiting in queues.

exercices.enonce: Complète : She's thinking about ___ (to change) jobs.
Complète : Have you finished ___ (to read) the book?
exercices.reponse: Have you finished reading the book?

exercices.enonce: Complète : He promised ___ (to call) me back.
exercices.reponse: He promised to call me back.

exercices.enonce: Complète : We look forward to ___ (to hear) from you.
corrige: to est ici une préposition → gérondif.
exercices.reponse: We look forward to hearing from you.

exercices.enonce: Traduis les deux : « Il s'est arrêté pour se reposer » / « Il a arrêté de travailler ».
corrige: stop + to = but : stopped to rest.
exercices.reponse: He stopped to rest. / He stopped working.

exercices.enonce: Choisis la forme : « I remember ___ (to post) that letter yesterday. »
exercices.reponse: I remember posting that letter yesterday.

exercices.enonce: Corrige : « I enjoy to travel and I want visiting Japan. »
exercices.reponse: I enjoy travelling and I want to visit Japan.

exercices.enonce: Explique la différence : « Try to sleep. » vs « Try sleeping with earplugs. »
exercices.reponse: Try to sleep = fais l'effort de dormir ; Try sleeping with earplugs = teste cette solution.
